To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the directed flow for identified particles is measured in Au+Au collision at GeV and the result is compared to the UrQMD model.
the directed flow of identified particles is observed to be negative at all centralities, and the magnitude of directed flow increases with increasing centrality and decreasing transverse momentum.
the directed flow for K0s and pions are consistent within errors, but K0s have a larger directed flow than pions.
